meta.title: Schub — the Miam community toolkit
meta.description: Schub gathers the tools of the Miam Discord community: game servers started on demand, and what it takes to keep a League of Legends team going — roster, statistics, champion pool, draft preparation.

hero.title: The Miam community toolkit
hero.subtitle: Game servers that switch on when you need them and, for League of Legends, what it takes to keep a team going.

about.title: What Schub does
about.community: Schub is the toolkit of the Miam Discord community: its game servers, its League of Legends teams, and the tools added as needs arise. It may open to a wider circle one day, once the tools are proven and stable — for now, it is built for us.
about.servers: Game servers are hosted at home and driven from the site or from Discord: their state is visible live, and starting or stopping one is a button. Port forwarding opens and closes along with the server.
about.lol: On the League of Legends side, Schub reads your games through Riot's API: personal and team statistics, champion pool by role, draft preparation and post-game review.
about.identity: Identity goes through Discord. There is no password to remember, and rights follow your role.
about.ctaLol: Open the League of Legends tool

onboarding.signedOutBody: Server status is public, but starting a server, linking your League of Legends account and joining a team all need a Discord account.
